message.title: Bouvet ASA   Invitation to Presentation of Third Quarter 2026 Results
message.body:
Bouvet ASA will release its results for the third quarter of 2026 on
Wednesday, 4 November 2026. In connection with the release, investors,
analysts and media representatives are invited to attend the results
presentation.

Date: 4 November 2026
Time: 08:30 CET
Venue: Bouvet, Sørkedalsveien 8, Oslo
Language: Norwegian

The presentation can also be followed via webcast:
https://vimeo.com/event/6306242

The complete quarterly report and presentation materials will be published at
www.bouvet.no/investor and www.newsweb.no.

Contact:
Steffen Garder, CFO | Phone: +47 930 99 940 | Email: steffen.garder@bouvet.no
